property_summary: For every admissible sequence of lockInGuess and settle calls, a settle call made in the same block as a successful lockInGuess must revert in the reference, because the lock is set to block.number+1 and the require(block.number > guesses[msg.sender].block) fails; the mutant weakens that check to require(true), so settle no longer reverts in that same block, which is observable by comparing the try/catch revert flag.
change_summary: Weaken the block-number check to a tautology so settle can run in the same block as lockInGuess.
